findings: Background activity can still call v085InstallWorld(false) while the player is on another screen.
The canonical renderer previously calculated a complete home snapshot and could rebuild hidden Startseite DOM even though the user could not see it.
changes: Non-forced v085InstallWorld calls now return immediately when #world is not active.
State is caught up when the player actually enters Startseite because v032Go('world') already schedules the canonical installer.
Forced renders still work while the world screen is inactive.
No gameplay, rewards, navigation state or stable behavior changed.
